{{Top|leg}}
'''Leilani''' was the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan's]] sister [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Delaya/Legends|Delaya]]. The [[City/Legends|city]] was packed with faceless [[Duracrete/Legends|duracrete]] factories that produced large amounts of smog. It had narrow streets and many unfinished construction buildings that littered the landscape.<ref name="hostage">''[[Rebel Force: Hostage]]''</ref>

Shortly after the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction of Alderaan]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], the city was full of [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] refugees too poor to leave the planet. [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] visited the planet to monitor the refugee problem, as well as recruit new soldiers for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="hostage" />
